answer: `jobs.<job_id>.secrets` in the calling workflow must use secret names that are defined by `on.workflow_call.secrets` in the reusable workflow. GitHub Docs says the secret identifier in the caller "must match the names defined in the called workflow"; if you want to pass `github-token`, the reusable workflow must declare `on.workflow_call.secrets.github-token` (or use `secrets: inherit` to pass all caller secrets). Your current reusable workflow only passes `with: github-token: ...` to the action, but it does not define a reusable-workflow secret named `github-token`, so the caller fails validation.
